review_title: Neural PDE solver energy and break-even against classical solvers (scoping review)

exclusion_codes.label: Publication type (editorial, erratum, letter, news, abstract only, patent, dataset; review or survey with no new computation)
Not solving PDEs with a neural PDE solver
No computational cost, time, energy, power or carbon element (accuracy or theory only; energy only as a physical quantity)
Cost only for the neural model or against other neural models, with no energy, power or carbon reported

Runtime, speed-up or FLOP comparison with a classical solver with no energy element and no repeated-use element (break-even, amortization, offline-plus-online accounting; parametric or many-query workload for physics-informed models)

core_criteria: a neural PDE solver (PINN-family or other neural surrogate of a PDE)

a cost element: computational energy, power or carbon; or a comparison with a classical solver that involves repeated use (break-even, amortization, offline-plus-online cost, or a parametric or many-query workload)

personas.A: You are REVIEWER A, a computational scientist who builds physics-informed neural networks, neural operators and finite element and finite difference solvers, and who knows how their costs are measured.
personas.B: You are REVIEWER B, a systematic and scoping review methodologist who applies eligibility rules exactly as written and checks the order of exclusion codes.
